accounting_boundary.recommended_initial_reporting: Separate upfront gross CAPEX from exact 120-day operating electric charges; keep missing out-of-package and recurring costs visible. No 120-day sum called annual cost or whole-life optimum.
accounting_boundary.energy_charges: Sum separately metered compressor+fan+pump/defrost/standby energy under exact dated applicable tariff after performance boundary is verified; cooling/heat rejection treatment explicit.
accounting_boundary.package_boundary: Source package to connection before user indoor main heating pipes, not site grid upgrade or indoor terminal retrofit.
accounting_boundary.existing_assets: Need finite source/service identity; sunk asset charge only excluded by explicit retrofit protocol, not assumed to be absent/free.
accounting_boundary.same_service: Same physical prototype, climate, comfort, gains, start/end temperature, electric boundary and operating service across all plans.
accounting_boundary.no_complete_scalar_objective_yet: An optimiser minimising CAPEX + 120-day bill can be a new explicitly declared short-horizon purchasing scenario once technical/cost inputs close, but is not a life-cycle economic claim. Before that only separate ledgers/threshold equations are admissible.
accounting_boundary.possible_financial_followup: A five-year analysis horizon may be a declared research convention within the warranty interval; it is not evidence of physical life and still needs recurring OM and weather/tariff repeat/escalation/discount assumptions. Do not reuse 5y warranty as life automatically.
unpriced_terms_remain_null: Package auxiliary energy not covered in measured COP
double_counting_controls: No duplicate CAPEX for the included pump/buffer/installation
No duplicate generic repair fee for warranty-covered defects
No application of time-of-use multipliers to published final bucket prices
No additional VAT on tax-included package without accounting evidence
No blending project forecasts with observed costs or gross package with net-of-tax forecasts
